[NDBG.15.9] The adapter emits these DS-specific events in addition to
the standard DAP event stream. All carry `type: "event"` and a
`event` string prefixed `"ds/"`. They are off by default: the adapter must
send only the kinds the `events` launch argument ([NDBG.9.3.1]) or
`ds/streamEvents` ([NDBG.14.20]) chose, and only while the session moves
forward, never moving back or re-driving from a checkpoint. Their ids are
[NDBG.9.3.5]'s.
